recs.stt: Ask HN: Has there been a "software crisis" since the 60s?
recs.x:
We've had other crisis since then and do right now. But they are not the same as that specific crisis. Our programming capacities did increase with the adoption of structured programming.

If you haven't, you should watch "The root of the root of all evil" by Casey Muratori which discusses this whole train of thought in much further detail. [link]
